profile.headline: SWE II at Datadog

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.locationName: New York City Metropolitan Area · On-site
positions.description: Worked on improvements in the Datadog Agent and the Go Tracer, including bug fixes, implementing customer requests, and new features.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description: Developed a Flipper plugin to debug a framework in the Instagram Android app.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
- Use React JS and D3 to create web visualizations of PPP Loans data for the LobbyView website. 
- Study the impact of PPP loans through the 2020 CARES Act on small businesses in the USA

positions.title: Google Computer Science Summer Institute: Online Student
positions.description:
- Selected as one of about 300 participants of a CS program for incoming college freshmen
- Completed a project-based Javascript curriculum taught by Google engineers
- Presented a collaborative final project in a live demonstration to Google employees and community leaders

positions.title: Director
positions.description:
- Director of a student run hackathon with ~100 participants/year
- Teach programming workshops in Java
- Contact and obtained sponsorships from tech companies such as Balsamiq, GitHub, and Jane Street
- Raised over $2000 over one year to provide a free learning experience for students

positions.title: Head Coach
positions.description:
- Taught competition math to middle school students
- Registered the team for competitions, such as Mathcounts and the Carderock Math Contest
- Organized club meetings and school level contests
- Traveled as a coach and volunteer to regional/state competitions.

company.name: The Johns Hopkins University Applied Physics Laboratory

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
- Applied topological data analysis (TDA) to various weather variables
- Identified relationships between climate and California wildfires
- Used machine learning to determine ways of predicting/forecasting wildfires
- Wrote and published a paper in MDPI Climate

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: Worked with social networking in R to identify relationships and strengths between employees using Jaccard's index/similarity coefficients to increase efficiency and enable quicker information spread.

volunteerExperiences.description: Assisted athletes with intellectual and physical disabilities at weekly bowling practices.
